description:
**Site (apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/loop.ex L262-271)**
\`\`\`elixir
def handle_call({:agent_follow_up, text}, _from, state) do
  OctoPi.Agent.follow_up(state.agent_pid, text)   # returns :ok | {:error, :full}
  {:reply, :ok, state}
end

def handle_call({:agent_steer, text}, _from, state) do
  OctoPi.Agent.steer(state.agent_pid, text)
  {:reply, :ok, state}
end
\`\`\`

The result of OctoPi.Agent.steer / follow_up is discarded; Coder always
returns :ok. Callers (the TUI, RPC mode, extensions) cannot detect when
the queue rejected an enqueue because of the bound.

**Spec mismatch (apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder.ex L84-88)**
\`\`\`elixir
@spec follow_up(t(), String.t()) :: :ok
def follow_up(server, text), ...

@spec steer(t(), String.t()) :: :ok
def steer(server, text), ...
\`\`\`
The spec is :ok-only and matches the swallow behavior; both the spec
and the implementation should propagate :full.

**Fix**
1. Update specs to :ok | {:error, :full}.
2. Forward the agent's return value:
   \`\`\`elixir
   {:reply, OctoPi.Agent.follow_up(state.agent_pid, text), state}
   \`\`\`
3. TUI / RPC / extension callers should surface a notification on :full.
title: [BUG] Coder.steer / Coder.follow_up swallow {:error, :full}
